disagreements.title: Next is far below the chosen slot on phones, with no prompt to continue
disagreements.a_reason: At 375 px the only primary action sits about 590 px below the chosen slot, past six more rows, and the only acknowledgement is a fill change. A resident booking on a phone may not see how to continue. No seeded defect covers this.
disagreements.b_reason: A continue button at the end of the form is the standard pattern, and the chosen slot shows as selected. The finding gives no evidence that residents fail to scroll down to Next.

assertions.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
